title: Glessner's stone courses measured against an 1880s photograph
items: Nothing in the town's appearance changes yet. Measured on a photograph from about 1888, the Glessner house's granite courses above the door stand about 4.5% taller than the model lays them. That agrees with the 1965 survey, so the walls will be re-coursed.
The same photograph shows the tall courses standing out further than the short ones. The model gives both the same depth, and a follow-up will deepen the tall ones.
